topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Rain's been hammering against the windows all night, like the city's got a mind to tear itself apart. Got a call today, the whole building I've called home – shifting from rent to condo. Old Mr. Jenkins on the first floor, he sounded lost when he told me over the neighbors’ ruckus. Guess it's the times we live in. Everyone's looking for a piece of the pie, even if it means cutting ties with the past. I’m not leaving this place easy. Not after what we’ve been through. I'll stick around, see what I can do. Maybe there’s a way to keep this boat afloat, one more time.
